You pay twenty dollars a month for Claude Pro. So how much is Anthropic actually earning on my subscription?
Computers take about eleven dollars and sixty-three cents.
People, about two dollars. Sales and partners, two seventy-eight.
Charity, paid in shares, about two thirty-six. Everything else, one eighty-seven.
So Anthropic loses about sixty-seven cents on your twenty dollars. Interest brings it back above zero.
But on paper, it lost twenty-three billion dollars in one quarter. Why? Full breakdown on the channel.
